authorization: User requested a redesigned experiment and non-experimental slide revisions; model runs are not started in this turn
question: At a fixed context capacity, separate newly available labels from admitted rows and measure new-class adaptation, paired old-class retention, and update cost
historical_100_rationale: Presentation example among explored budgets; not a statistical median, optimum, empirical minimum, or operationally justified quota

admission.rationale: Engineering limits of 5%, 10%, 20% replacement per update, not optimized or selected from test scores
admission.effective_total: min(total incoming rows, max_rows_per_stage, B - sum(old class protected floors))
admission.allocation: Equal quotas across classes introduced at the same stage; largest remainder with stable class-ID tie breaking; respect per-class availability; at least one per new class
admission.selection: Per-new-class greedy farthest-first selection after scaling by initial 1000 rows only; first point nearest candidate centroid; ties by saved train row ID; all methods receive identical admitted IDs
admission.rejected_rows: Count in available-label budget and selection time; discard after this update; never retrieve rejected or evicted rows later
admission.storage: 1000 is persistent context capacity, not a bound on temporary candidate storage or total GPU memory; log transient candidate rows and peak memory

protection.actual_floor: min(nominal minimum, number of that class ever admitted); initial benign has 750; old attack floors apply before eviction
protection.rationale: Hypothesized support protection against depletion; these are engineering constraints rather than proven optimal counts
protection.sensitivity: At n=400, compare protected random eviction with cap-only random eviction (one old example per class)

eviction.fifo: Oldest acquisition stage first; within-stage ties use a saved seed-43 random ordering independent of class/file ordering; skip protected rows
eviction.random: Stage-seeded random order over current old context; skip rows that would violate floors
eviction.similar: Old rows ranked by minimum Euclidean distance to admitted new rows under initial-only scaling; skip protected rows; record cross-label eviction diagnostics

matched_context_control: XGB refit on the exact pfn_capped_protected_random context at each stage; reported separately from cumulative XGB

extra_configurations_per_dataset: q100 protection on with random admission
sensitivity.selection: Conditions fixed before execution; do not choose a method using final test outcomes

model.checkpoint: same recorded TabPFN v3 checkpoint as EXP83

evaluation.main: Final state on complete fixed held-out test, identical mixed order and query batch 8192
evaluation.stage_panel: Seed-43 sample of up to 2000 fixed-test rows per class; fixed ID list and fixed label-independent query order across all stages; labels used only for sampling and metrics
evaluation.panel_queries: The same fixed panel may include future-class query features; no query labels enter fitting, context selection, preprocessing or admission; unknown-class detection is not scored
evaluation.stage_known_metrics: Confusion matrix for rows of currently introduced classes, with label-set mapping explicit
evaluation.paired_old_retention: For update t, compare model states t-1 and t on exactly the same fixed panel rows from classes known before t; use the same old-class evaluation population for both scores
evaluation.joint_false_positives: Also report per-class precision/F1 from the full currently-known population, including newly introduced classes; old-only F1 does not include new-to-old false positives
evaluation.new_metrics: Per-class recall/F1 for just-introduced and all post-initial attack classes; full currently-known population supplies false positives
diagnostics: per-class context count at every stage
fixed original-class panel score through all stages
evaluation.interpretation: Single-seed exploratory evidence; previous test inspection disclosed; no statistical equivalence or minimum-label guarantee
evaluation.stage_panel_role: Offline post-hoc evaluation of saved stage models, not a causal temporal replay

cost.primary: GPU-synchronized wall time for admission + eviction + model construction + preprocessing + fit/cache preparation, summed after initial stage
cost.measurement: Sequential GPU runs, identical hardware and settings, same 4-estimator PFN, no concurrent experiment workers; single seed; log warm-up policy
cost.cache_note: Even a small admission count may rebuild the entire 1000-row context cache. The cap controls turnover; fixed B bounds context size. Neither implies an incremental cache update.
cost.historical: Old prediction scores may be an explicitly labelled reference; do not combine old and new timing to claim a speedup

preflight: Train and test row IDs disjoint
Nested available sets reuse EXP77/78/80 IDs
No future-label, rejected-row or evicted-row reuse
Admission and all protection constraints feasible
Same admitted IDs across PFN policies
Same matched-buffer IDs for PFN and XGB
output: Save source snapshots, ID plans, contexts, class counts, predictions, confusion matrices, component times and provenance; write Korean detailed LaTeX/PDF and one-line log

icd_reference.title: In-Context Data Distillation with TabPFN
icd_reference.mechanism: Frozen model weights; gradient optimization of distilled context features; fixed context labels
icd_reference.paper_configuration: 1000 class-balanced distilled points, Adam lr 0.01, validation-AUC early stopping on static OpenML tasks
icd_reference.scope_gap: Original TabPFN and static full-training-data access; neither incremental class arrival nor bounded retention of raw history established
icd_reference.exp75_distinction: V3 adaptation already exists: at most 2048 context rows, one estimator, 100k cumulative train, separate validation, stage-pooled replay; not the proposed small-label final-state test

icd_pilot.purpose: Measure whether learning context features improves compression beyond the same initialized context, and at what update cost
icd_pilot.data_access: All cumulative released raw training rows may be revisited for the objective; explicitly NOT a strict bounded-raw-history policy
icd_pilot.label_allocation: As equal as possible across currently seen classes; fixed within each stage; this differs from benign-protected real-row buffers
icd_pilot.initialization: At each stage, reserve at least half of each class as distinct real query IDs; initialize 1000 class-balanced tokens from the remaining seed IDs, repeating seed rows when necessary; save distinct ID counts and token multiplicities
icd_pilot.carryover: Reinitialize each stage from currently available real train rows using fixed seed; no claim of warm-start streaming ICD
icd_pilot.objective: Empirical cross-entropy on withheld real training-query rows from all seen classes; query batch 256 sampled with replacement; no test or additional validation labels
icd_pilot.optimizer: Adam lr 0.01 on context features only; fixed snapshots at steps 0, 20, 100; report all snapshots, no test-based selection or early stopping
icd_pilot.backbone: Same v3 checkpoint, one differentiable estimator as existing EXP75; matched untuned control uses exactly the same estimator, preprocessing, initialization, labels and query protocol
icd_pilot.preprocessing: Initial-1000-only fixed scaler, same transform in all paired states; preserve and verify the local finite-gradient preprocessing fixes, without changing installed package files
icd_pilot.cost: Initialization + all context-gradient steps + final inference/cache preparation, with initial-stage cost separate; per-stage later update sum; include optimizer peak memory
icd_pilot.strict_comparability: Judge optimization gain against step 0. Differences against 4-estimator real-row buffers include estimator, preprocessing, label allocation, access and duplicate-token differences.
icd_pilot.synthetic_scope: Only learned model-input context tokens are synthetic; original IDS train/test observations are not combined across datasets or synthetically generated
validation: backbone gradients absent and hashes unchanged
exactly 1000 context tokens, unique labelled IDs separately counted
final complete test and paired old-class panel
icd_pilot.extension_boundary: A truly bounded-history ICD update needs an explicit replay or anchor-memory budget; cumulative-history ICD does not establish that property
